title: Protocol Composition Risk Register
description: Schema for the protocol composition risk register. Tracks cross-surface escalation risks, missing mitigations, and required tests and schema receipts.

register_id.description: Unique identifier for this risk register.

title.description: Human-readable title of the risk register.

content_light.description: Whether this artifact is safe for content-light transmission. Must be true for all governance artifacts.

risk_id.description: Unique identifier for this risk entry (e.g., comp-risk-001).

name.description: Short, descriptive name for the risk.

attack_path.description: Description of the attack path: how an attacker could chain across surfaces to escalate privileges or bypass governance.

current_mitigation.description: What mitigation exists today, if any. Use 'None — not implemented' if no mitigation exists.

missing_mitigation.description: What mitigation is still needed to close this risk.

required_schema_receipt.description: Path to the schema receipt or spec that must exist before this risk can be considered mitigated.

required_test.description: Description of the test that must pass to verify this risk is mitigated.

blocking_status.description: Whether this risk blocks release, mutation surface exposure, hosted mode, or is non-blocking/future.

surfaces_involved.description: Protocol surfaces involved in this composition risk.

priority.description: Priority level for addressing this risk.

related_test_ids.description: Test IDs from the surface test strategy that cover this risk.

related_roadmap_items.description: Roadmap item IDs that address this risk.

notes.description: Additional context or notes about this risk.
